messages:
maya: Heads up — we need to publish the v1->v2 deprecation notice for model aliases + embed-dim swaps. I started a migration guide draft but want a quick checklist of snippets/redirects that absolutely must be fixed before we announce.

sam: Which PR is this?

maya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — deprecation + migration guide draft, includes timeline and example callsites.

joel: Skimmed it. Missing: streaming callback snippet rewrite and the SDK param rename example (`invoke` -> `responses`). I can push a tiny PR to replace inline examples.

lia: Also need a small compatibility snippet for embeddings vector dims. Some customers use 1024, others 1536. Add mapping example and a warning block.

sam: Can we auto-run docs smoke tests after we land snippet changes? I can wire a check.

docs-bot: @channel smoke test job queued: `docs-smoke/migration-check` -> https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/5678 (will run after PR merge) :gear:

joel: I'll add a short redirect map JSON to the PR so internal permalinks don't 404. Example I'm going to include: 

joel: ```
{"redirects": [
  {"from": "/api/v1/models", "to": "/api/v2/models"},
  {"from": "/docs/embeds/old-dim", "to": "/docs/embeds/dim-mapping"}
]}
```

maya: Nice. Plan: land docs PR, merge snippet updates, tag SDK owners to publish patch. Schedule deprecation announcement for Monday (2-week grace). @sam can you own the rollout comms? :eyes: 

sam: Yep. I'll coordinate with growth for the email copy + blog blurb, and check Dedicated/Private notes for any extra impact.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: `docs-site` -> staging at 1748890200; will auto-promote after smoke tests pass.

maya: Thanks. Quick follow-up: add a note about graceful fallback order (alias -> compatible model -> cheaper fallback) and an example of how to pin model versions in config.

lia: Adding the fallback snippet now and a small note about KMS-protected private deployments.

joel: Pushed the SDK snippet changes and redirect JSON to the PR branch. Leaving inline comments for reviewers.

sam: I'll monitor CI and give thumbs when smoke passes.

maya: Great, thank you — once merged I'll post the deprecation notice in #announcements and notify enterprise reps.
